clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00569 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line metastatic non-squamous NSCLC without EGFR or ALK alterations.

treatment.schedule_summary: Every 21 days: up to four triplet induction cycles, then pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed maintenance until progression/unacceptable toxicity.

phases.duration: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity; consultant plan

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, grade it with its own CTCAE criteria and assess functional impact before selecting a grade.

hearing_or_tinnitus.label: Clinically significant hearing impairment or tinnitus

neuropathy_grade.label: Treatment-emergent neurotoxicity grade (baseline neuropathy is assessed separately)

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only. CTCAE v5.0 grades symptomatic paraesthesia separately when that is the more accurate term.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms that limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and motor symptoms, gait, dexterity and impact on instrumental or self-care activities.

folic_acid_b12_given.label: Folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation in place

mucositis_grade.label: Oral mucositis/stomatitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No oral mucositis.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe pain that interferes with oral intake.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Inspect oral mucosa and assess pain, diet modification and ability to maintain oral intake.

pneumonitis_grade.label: Immune-mediated pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No pneumonitis.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; medical intervention indicated; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; oxygen indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention such as ventilatory support required.

pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess symptoms, oxygen requirement, imaging and exclude infection/alternative causes.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.label: Immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: Neither diarrhoea nor colitis is present.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Diarrhoea: fewer than 4 stools/day above baseline or mild ostomy-output increase. Colitis: asymptomatic, clinical/diagnostic observations only.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Diarrhoea: 4-6 stools/day above baseline or moderate ostomy-output increase; limits instrumental ADL. Colitis: abdominal pain or mucus/blood in stool.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Diarrhoea: at least 7 stools/day above baseline, incontinence, hospitalisation or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care ADL. Colitis: severe abdominal pain or peritoneal signs.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening diarrhoea or colitis; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess stool frequency over baseline, abdominal pain, blood/mucus, hydration, sepsis and peritoneal signs.

rash_grade.label: Immune-mediated rash/dermatitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No rash. Use the most specific CTCAE skin term when a rash is present.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: For maculopapular rash: under 10% body-surface area, with or without symptoms such as itch, burning or tightness.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: For maculopapular rash: 10–30% body-surface area, or rash limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: For maculopapular rash: over 30% body-surface area with moderate/severe symptoms, or limitation of self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 is not defined for uncomplicated maculopapular rash; use the appropriate severe cutaneous-reaction term if life-threatening features are present.

rash_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess morphology, body-surface area, symptoms, mucosal involvement and functional impact.

infusion_reaction_grade.label: Infusion-related reaction grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No infusion-related or hypersensitivity reaction.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption of the infusion is not indicated; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Infusion interruption or treatment is indicated, with prompt response to symptomatic medication; prophylaxis may be needed for 24 hours or less.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Prolonged symptoms not rapidly responsive to treatment/brief interruption, or recurrence after initial improvement; hospitalisation indicated for clinical sequelae.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

infusion_reaction_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess timing, intervention, airway or haemodynamic compromise and recovery.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST results (actual values entered; highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

bilirubin_uln_multiple.label: Bilirubin result (actual value entered; ×ULN calculated automatically)

creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.label: Creatinine / laboratory ULN (immune nephritis; do not use baseline ratio)
creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.help: NCCP 00568 v5 Table 3 uses creatinine relative to laboratory ULN. This does not calculate CrCl/GFR or establish a diagnosis of immune nephritis.
creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.assessment_guidance: Source Table 3 uses ULN. The stored input key is retained for portability but the entered ratio must be creatinine divided by the laboratory ULN.

cortisol_nmol_l.label: Cortisol (optional; interpret by sample time and steroid exposure)

ketones_mmol_l.label: Blood ketones (optional if hyperglycaemia or symptoms)

previous_febrile_neutropenia.label: Febrile neutropenia since the previous chemotherapy dose

immunosuppressive_systemic_therapy.label: Systemic immunosuppression above 10 mg/day prednisolone equivalent (excluding topical/inhaled)

suspected_sjs_ten.label: Suspected Stevens–Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis

confirmed_sjs_ten.label: Confirmed Stevens–Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis

other_immune_grade2_3.label: Other immune-related toxicity requiring withholding (grade 2 or 3, depending on type)

immune_permanent_stop_event.label: Grade 4 or recurrent grade 3 immune toxicity; or grade 3–4 myocarditis, encephalitis or Guillain–Barré syndrome

ici_failed_recovery_12_weeks.label: Treatment-related toxicity has not recovered to grade 0–1 within 12 weeks after last pembrolizumab

ici_steroid_gt10_at_12_weeks.label: Unable to reduce systemic prednisone equivalent to ≤10 mg/day within 12 weeks

immune_liver_metastasis_baseline_g2.label: Liver metastases with baseline grade 2 AST/ALT elevation

diarrhoea_hospitalisation.label: Diarrhoea of any grade requiring hospitalisation

prior_chemotherapy_dose_reductions.label: Number of previous pemetrexed/cisplatin dose reductions

baseline_neuropathy_grade2_plus.label: Pre-existing neuropathy grade ≥2 before starting cisplatin
